claimed_feature_support.note: LangChain framework operations implemented in this probe. A framework operation succeeding OFFLINE says nothing about live provider semantics or model support; both remain UNVERIFIED until a live run (DevSpec Section 55). Framework behavior (message conversion, structured-output strategy, tool binding, streaming aggregation, usage propagation, exception wrapping) is the audit subject, not a capability claim.
claimed_feature_support.structured_output: framework_operation_implemented (with_structured_output; strategy recorded in raw evidence)
claimed_feature_support.errors: framework_operation_implemented (framework exception type + underlying cause chain captured)

framework_boundary_notes: LangChain may transform provider-native events into framework chunk/message objects; native OpenAI Responses event names are NOT guaranteed to survive the boundary. The distinction is recorded as evidence, never assumed equivalent.
usage_metadata is LangChain's normalized shape; it is not byte-identical to the provider's raw usage block. Missing usage stays absent, never coerced to zero.
with_structured_output selects a strategy (function/tool calling, json_schema, or a parser); the selected strategy is preserved in raw evidence rather than assumed to be provider-native strict mode.
known_limitations: No live evidence exists yet; all P0.5 verification is offline via a narrow injected fake chat model that exercises real LangChain machinery without the network.
Parallel tools, cancellation, timeout, retry, embeddings, and multimodal are out of P0.5 scope.
The probe emits raw evidence and a minimal manifest only; normalization is a harness stage.
No OpenRouter, gateway, or custom base_url is configured; only a direct OPENAI_API_KEY satisfies the live credential gate.
